description: Hopper FullFlow inputs. Unit suffixes are authoritative; pressures are absolute (psia) unless a difference (psi) or gauge (psig). Paths are relative to this file. Null tube OD/wall means unmeasured; ID is then required. Tag values with a "note" on the component, or in the notes section by JSON path: "EDIT" = expected to change, "GUESS" = nobody has confirmed it. Notes feed the component table and the parameter workbook.

sequence.note: Flight startup (user, 2026-11-10): OIMV T+0.08, FIMV T+0.19, both close 55 ms after main ignition (sequence.main_ignition_s); TFPV opens 30 ms after main ignition and closes 0.1 s after the last main purge ends. Each valve's open_time_s / close_time_s below is its stroke.

network.note: Explicit torch fluid network. The independent cold-gas purge runner uses its purge leg, shared injector, chamber and throat. Keep torch.enabled false: full vehicle/combustion coupling is pending.

temperature_rise.note: INPUT [seconds since torch valves begin opening, Tout minus Tin in K]. Linear interpolation, held endpoints. No heating before torch opening. Unused in the independent cold-gas purge calculation.

elements.note: Ox torch heat exchanger treated hydraulically as a tube. INPUT length and ID or OD/wall. Roughness and zero height are placeholders. No vaporization/phase-change model is implied.

elements.name: Torch Ox Injector
elements.note: INPUT torch oxidizer injector CdA.

chamber.name: Torch Chamber
chamber.note: User initial/imposed pressure 150 psia. 293 K is an explicit cold-nitrogen purge assumption, not a combustion temperature.

throat.name: Torch Throat
throat.note: Geometric throat area, no separate discharge coefficient. Independent purge run uses ideal bidirectional compressible throat flow.

sequence.note: EDIT THE ENTIRE TORCH PURGE TIMELINE HERE. Absolute simulation seconds; valves hold their last command (0=closed, 1=open). Torch pressure holds its initial 150 psia until release_torch_pressure. The 7 s purge close is an editable example.

standalone_purge.note: Purge-only cold ideal nitrogen model. Edit ALL timing in sequence above. Hold initial torch pressure until the release event, then integrate chamber mass/energy. Main pressure uses held step values. Null supply pressure derives the same regulator outlet as the main purges. No fuel/oxidizer flow, combustion or liquid flushing. Main reservoir is also cold nitrogen; its temperature is editable.

sequence.note: OPV opens as the main oxidizer valve closes
FPV opens as the main fuel valve closes

not_modelled.PRQD: Pressurant fill quick disconnect (disconnected in flight)
not_modelled.OQD: LOX fill quick disconnect below OFD (disconnected in flight)
not_modelled.FQD: Fuel fill quick disconnect, McMaster 52495K63 (disconnected in flight)
not_modelled.ODiff: Oxygen diffuser on the OVNT exhaust (sizing)
not_modelled.Torch spark igniter: Spark / exciter and torch combustion are not yet modelled. Explicit fluids topology is configured under torch.network; its solver is pending.

Initial COPV pressure.note: EDIT +-2 % (user); one draw, the bottles are filled together

notes.simulation.maximum_step_s: 0.05 s gives the same engine results as 0.01 s in ~40 % of the time; the bang-bang is sampled less often, so tank pressure overshoots ~10 psi more. Use 0.01 to study the tank band.
notes.pressurization.copv_model: lumped: all bottles as one volume (user, needs identical bottles). header: each bottle feeding a common header (Vedanth, 2026-11-05), for bottles that differ; stiff, so it needs maximum_step_s near 0.005
notes.pressurization.header_volume_l: GUESS used only by copv_model header; placeholder (Vedanth, 2026-11-05), needs measured plumbing
notes.pressurization.controller_period_s: Bang-bang sampled once per time step, as a flight computer sampling its transducer
notes.engine.mixture_ratio: EDIT target O/F (user, 2026-10-30; was 1.8 from vehicle_sim)
notes.sequence.main_fuel_open_s: Startup (user, 2026-11-10): FTV starts opening after the 100 ms torch Pc check; its flow ramps to the first profile point by main_ignition_s
notes.sequence.main_ignition_s: Startup (user, 2026-11-10): both flows reach the first thrust-profile point; profile time 0
notes.sequence.ox_close_after_shutdown_s: Shutdown (user, 2026-11-10): OTV closes first at the shutdown request (end of the thrust profile), fuel-rich shutdown
notes.sequence.fuel_close_after_shutdown_s: Shutdown (user, 2026-11-10): FTV closes 0.1 s after OTV
notes.sequence.step_smoothing_s: Shortest OTV/FTV move between profile points
notes.sequence.throttle_rate_limit_lbf_s: EDIT thrust slew limit (GNC fluid-network slides: 180 lbf/s sim, 90 lbf/s MC). null = step in step_smoothing_s (vehicle_sim-like)
notes.sequence.ramp_breakpoint_spacing_s: Solver steps no longer than this through the opening / closing ramps
notes.outputs.keep_run_history: false keeps only the latest raw history (Outputs/Hopper_Prop_System.h5, ~220 MB); true also keeps one in every run archive
notes.purge.sequence: Shutdown (user, 2026-11-10): OPV opens with the OTV close, FPV with the FTV close, 2 s each; times from the shutdown request (end of the thrust profile). Was fuel 5 s then LOX 5 s (2026-11-08)
notes.purge.simulate_in_transient: true opens the purge valves in the full transient after shutdown, so the COPV drain is simulated
notes.torch.enabled: true: the flight sim solves torch.network (torch chamber, throat into the main chamber, TFPV purge) on torch.sequence. false: torch not in the flight sim. The independent torch purge runner works either way.
notes.torch.open_time_s: Legacy torch.branches window only; the network uses torch.sequence
notes.torch.duration_s: Legacy torch.branches window only; the network uses torch.sequence
notes.torch.valve_stroke_s: Legacy torch.branches window only; network valve strokes are open_time_s / close_time_s on each valve
notes.torch.standalone_purge.sequence: EDIT all independent torch event times, valve commands, main pressure steps, pressure release and run end here. This is separate from the vehicle Fuel Purge / LOX Purge sequence.
